### WeWork Oberoi Commerz II Goregaon East : A Comprehensive Review

WeWork Oberoi Commerz II, located in the bustling commercial hub of Mumbai, offers a modern and vibrant coworking space. With its contemporary design and dynamic atmosphere, it attracts a diverse range of professionals and businesses. However, several practical and operational issues have been noted by its users.

### Parking Facilities
One of the significant drawbacks is the lack of parking for visitors. Clients must pay for monthly parking at a considerably high cost, which can be a deterrent for potential visitors and clients. This parking situation is inconvenient and adds to the overall expense of using the facility.

### Washroom Maintenance
The washrooms at WeWork Oberoi Commerz II are common and maintained by the tenants. Unfortunately, the hygiene standards are poor, with reports of broken WCs, unpleasant smells, and even cockroach infestations. This lack of cleanliness significantly detracts from the overall experience and raises concerns about the maintenance and management of shared facilities.

### WeWork Facilities
Inside WeWork, the facilities are generally impressive. The workspace is comfortable, with a cozy atmosphere and a young, energetic management team. There are frequent exhibitions and product showcases, which provide excellent networking opportunities and exposure to new ideas. The food court offers decent options, catering to a variety of tastes and preferences.

### Access Card Issues
The WeWork access card system has been reported to be unreliable. Despite being activated, the cards sometimes fail to work, causing frustration for users. Additionally, users must book their desk every morning through the WeWork app; otherwise, their card will not activate. This daily requirement adds an unnecessary layer of hassle and inconvenience.

### Support Staff

featured_reviews.name: Spidey thenameis
featured_reviews.review_text:
Please don’t judge me by my account name
,  I’m a real person sharing a genuine experience.

WeWork Raheja Platinum is honestly one of the best places to work. For me, it felt like a healing space, full of positivity, and the perfect environment to start work every day.

One incident really earned my respect for them:
I once forgot my small Nokia phone there. For an entire week, I didn’t even realize it was missing until I checked my bag and couldn’t find it. I searched everywhere at home but no luck. Finally, I asked the WeWork security team if they had found any phone matching my description. They asked for details about the day and place I last saw it — and to my surprise, they actually had my phone safe with them! They returned it to me without hesitation. That moment made me trust them blindly, because in many other offices, things like this just get lost, and sometimes even the CCTV doesn’t work properly. But here, the staff were so honest and professional.

Another time, I was feeling very sleepy on the 9th floor and dozed off on a chair in a weird position. The staff came quietly just to check if I was okay — without disturbing me. That showed how much they care for people’s well-being, not just their work.

I left WeWork some time back, but I know I’ll return someday — even if it’s just with a day pass. And I can’t forget to mention the beautiful, warm community team 🥹😍 — they truly made the place feel like home.

💙 Love you all guys 🫂
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Hi, your feedback made us smile! We're glad you had a great time, and we're looking forward to seeing you again in our spaces

featured_reviews.name: Deepesh Nadkarni
featured_reviews.review_text: WeWork is an excellent co-working space for freelancers, small business or corporate employees. They cater to all kind of masses and have open space to enclosed cabins to meet the different requirements. Other facilities like free beverages (tea/coffee) and recreational facilities like table tennis, carrom etc is an added advantage to get yourself relaxed from the work pressure. The only drawback is that the location of this property is away from the main road and secondly the monthly charges to be a part of wework space. Staff is good and cooperative and polite.

featured_reviews.review_text:
One of the best office premises I have worked in. The community managers are very friendly and professional and always up to help. All the common areas are clean and well maintained. The interior work is beautiful.

The prices are also affordable. This company will definitely make an impact in the Indian shared workspace market. Best of luck guys.. Incredible work and dedication.
